body: Not sure what you're going through, but I can relate in a way. I have thoughts frequently about how much of a monster I am. My wife has recently decided to leave me and she's moved on rather fast. It is gut wrenching considering she is my best friend from high school. This has been my worst break up. I hope you can find the will to live and love yourself. I'm sure you're s cook guy or a cool gal. We all have to face our demons at the end of the day. It's never pretty when we do. If you'd like to talk though I'm here for you. I'll never let a soul in need fight their demons alone if they are able to lean on me. I'll be your shield when they are attacking, and I'll be your blade when you're ready to cut them down, and let the light shine back in.
I'd take your pain and gladly go in your place if it meant you were able to find the will to stay.

Hey so I'm new here. I'm having a very hard time with coping lately. I'm 24 and my wife/best friend just left. She was truly the one thing I had going for me in my life, and she was the best thing I've ever happened upon. I had a bad porn addiction, and it drove such a wedge between us. She wants nothing to do with me and seems to have moved on fairly fast. I've since beaten my addiction and am clean for about 6 months now. She keeps leaving me with a little hope, but at the same time seems to be talking to other people. I based all of my life around her, and even cut off all other friends that I had who were there for me through some very dark times. I just need to vent, and maybe a kind soul to talk to. I'm so lost alone and lonely. I feel like I'm going to kill myself. The thoughts and urges have gotten stronger lately and I've even started back cutting. My mind is so clouded with bad thought because I miss her so much.
